rca_of_the_issue: Reported production symptom was caused by the Leads list default unscoped pipeline query hinting an index by the preview-only name active_createdate_id. Production/fresh DB auto-names that index active_1_create_date_-1_id_-1, so the name hint failed and produced constant 504/busy toast on Leads only. Fix changes the hint to key pattern and adds a no-hint fallback.
